16 teams12 courts2 sessions

A full afternoon of country competition.

Session 1 runs from 1:00–3:30 PM with 12 teams on 12 courts. Session 2 runs from 3:30–6:00 PM with four teams on four courts.

Each country has two scheduled team matches. Each match includes men’s doubles, women’s doubles, and two mixed doubles games.

All four doubles games are played to 11, win by two. At 2–2, an EPL Point Break decides the match: two mixed players, to 11, win by two.

Times and court assignments are transcribed from the Event 1 poster. Check BracketMesh for event updates.

LEARN THE LEAGUE

One match. Everyone in.

MLP-style team competition,
with the EPL Point Break finish.

2+2

A team of four.

Each country team has two men and two women. Teams face off across four doubles games, combining men’s, women’s, and mixed competition.

Doubles games to 11
Win by 2

  1. 01

    Men’s doubles

    Two men from each country go head to head.

    DOUBLES
  2. 02

    Women’s doubles

    Two women from each country take the court.

    DOUBLES
  3. 03

    Mixed doubles #1

    One man and one woman from each team.

    MIXED
  4. 04

    Mixed doubles #2

    The second mixed pairing completes the four games.

    MIXED
  5. 2–2?

    THE MATCH DECIDER

    EPL Point Break

    If tied 2–2, two mixed players play to 11, win by two.
